description: A React component for rendering a sidebar channel link in Mattermost, including tooltip, selection, and menu handling.

classes.name: SidebarChannelLink
classes.description: React component for a sidebar channel link with tooltip, selection, and menu functionalities.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes tooltip and fetches remote channel info if shared channel.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates tooltip and fetches remote info on channel change.

methods.name: enableToolTipIfNeeded
methods.description: Enables tooltip if label text overflows.

methods.name: getAriaLabel
methods.description: Generates accessible label for the channel link.

methods.name: handleChannelClick
methods.description: Handles click event on the channel link, including telemetry and RHS closing.

methods.name: handleSelectChannel
methods.description: Handles selection logic based on modifier keys.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the channel link with icons, labels, tooltips, and menu.
